Ore conversion, carbon-reset inventories and marine pressure-storage contracts
ROOT physical/source/cost calculations,12November2026Brisbane

This note contains engineering operations and conditional calculations. It supplies no demonstrated device, qualified material or commercial quotation.

Carbon-state and support-metal balance
For a nickel pump with a measured deficit Dmol of Ni(III), stoichiometric reset can remove at mostD/4mol O2. Neutral oxygen leakage does not create more deficit. N2/Ar remain impurities. Metallic Ni corrosion to Ni(II) can consume oxygen while providing2electron equivalents per Ni; this is a consumed support, not regenerated capacity.
Using declared Faraday/atomic-mass constants,1g consumedNi corresponds to0.91327Ah. In an illustrative0.1A,2.1h leg with8%charge deficit,18.40mg metallicNi oxidation could mimic the complete reset. A phase-specific assay is different from total mass gain.
For the available conditional cover coefficients Kc=5e-6,Kw=2.8e-7mol/m2/s/Pa,aw1,30C/20%RH, introduced saturation pressure4247Pa, and perfect-sink50%removal, the log-mean carbon pressure31.0635Pa implies at least2.507kg evaporatedwater/kgCO2 in the same-window transport surrogate. Patterning the common window does not change intrinsic vapor selectivity. Finite CO2 reaction pressure and access resistances worsen that screen, while another physical chemistry may change it.
At0.30V and0.282CO2/electron, normal idealized cell work is0.64786kWh/kg before other operations. Removing all0.180reset and0.299startup from the available1.464ledger still leaves0.985kWh/kg. These are route-specific screens, not all-concentrator bounds.
